name: Okeya Kyujiro

menus.name: Omakase dinner
menus.note: 25+ courses. Wednesday to Sunday, two sittings at 5:45pm and 8:15pm.

menus.name: Omakase lunch
menus.note: 15+ courses. Saturday and Sunday at 12:15pm (called brunch on the restaurant's FAQ).

menus.name: Ochakase tea omakase
menus.note: 12+ sweet and savoury courses with five Japanese teas. Saturdays at 2pm, held only now and then; gluten-free possible.

bookingOpens: Online on OpenTable. Dinner is served Wednesday to Sunday at two sittings, 5:45pm and 8:15pm, with lunch on Saturday and Sunday at 12:15pm. A credit card is needed to book. Seats at the counter are given out in order of arrival, and doors open 15 minutes before the booking time.
cancellation: Free to cancel more than 72 hours ahead; a partial charge may apply between 72 and 24 hours, and the full price is charged within 24 hours. Cancel through OpenTable or by email (info@kyujiro.ca).
groups: Groups of five or more book by phone or email and prepay the full omakase price plus a 20% service charge. The whole restaurant can be booked for the 8:15pm sitting only, for up to 14 guests.
children: No children's menu, and children pay the full price. The restaurant asks that babies and children under 5 not come.
duration: About two hours for dinner and an hour and a half for lunch.
byob: Guests may bring their own sake or wine, with corkage of $75 a 720ml bottle or $150 a 1.5-litre bottle.
